notes.title: "I PLAYED THESE GAMES BEFORE" - Update v1.1.7
notes.content:
[h1]Didn't expect this game to be updated anymore huh?[/h1]

[h2]Well YOU WERE WRONG bruv haha[/h2]



I fixed most of the annoyances, lag spikes, weirdness and improved gameplay. Let's kick things off with balance changes:

[h2]Balance changes[/h2]
- A Comically Large Spoon: Damage increased from 34HP -> 87HP (BUFF)
- Blue team now has more time to capture the Blueprints (30s -> 50s)
- Player now jumps slightly higher (5.0 units -> 5.5 units)

badass

[h2]Gameplay Fixes[/h2]
- Fixed voice chat
- You can now see the team you are on when the round starts in Blueprints
- Updated game engine from Redot 4.3 to Redot 4.4 Alpha
- Fixed lag spikes
- Weapons no longer auto-equipped if player is already holding another weapon (doesn't apply to trophy and nuke)
- Toaster now reloads more consistently
- Fixed chat not fading away after inactivity sometimes
- You may now set FPS to UNLIMITED (HELL YEAH)

[h2]Editor fixes[/h2]
- Fixed uploading maps without light baking. This caused issues where maps appeared very broken and were missing objects. You now have two options: proceed without baking lights (will cause bad lighting, but will now be playable) or bake lighting and submit the map. Broken maps need to be reuploaded to the workshop, as their editor version isn't accessible to me and I cannot fix them myself.
- An extra popup to explain the lighting baking process right before upload.
- Tooltips when hovering over objects in the editor

notes.title: While Mom's Away Patch Notes v1.1.6
notes.content:
hello people who have their moms away

This update (and yesterday's v1.1.5) bring much needed fixes which have almost caused me to go insane

[h3]Changes:[/h3]
- Increased drop rate of Comically Large Spoon. 
- Updated the shake effect for all weapons. Things look crisp as hell now
- A voice icon will now appear next to the player's name if they are talking using voice chat
- Player is no longer "glitchy" if either side is experiencing network issues.
- Fixed an issue where dropped weapons would sometimes not pick up for connected players
- Updated the tick-rate to reduce the bandwidth
- Server version is now shown in the lobby list menu
- "Max FPS" option in settings
- Comically Large Spoon no longer deals damage twice in certain scenarios

[h3]Map maker[/h3]
- [b]NEW OBJECT:[/b] Launch Pad
- Added a tutorial to explain keybinds in the map maker
- More objects can now have their color adjusted
- Fixed map upload
- Camera now doesn't turn into Lightning McQueen when you have a high-refresh-rate monitor.
- Custom maps are no longer selected by default in the map picker
- You can now playtest the final version of the map by clicking the > icon in menu


that's it for now boys. with all of that fixed, imma go cook a new content update so you have a reason to give a positive Steam review ːsteamthumbsupː

notes.title: While Mom's Away Patch Notes v1.1.4
notes.content:
[b]Daily update streak #2! 
[/b](it's just an excuse to publish a new version after a big one lol)

[h3]Balance changes[/h3]
- Spoon buffed (hitbox increased)

[h3]Other changes[/h3]
- Removed money from the Buy Menu. It didn't make sense and I have a better idea planned for the Blueprints gamemode
- Moved chat lower
- Comically Large Spoon can now break glass

Until tomorrow I guess ːsteamhappyː

notes.content:

starting off...

- [b]2 NEW MAPS: Verticality[/b] and [b]Eight[/b]

[h2]Changes:[/h2]
- You can no longer shoot your teammates in Blueprints
- Players in Blueprints are now randomly distributed across teams (Blue team has an advantage of +1 player)


[h2]Balance changes:[/h2]
- Port: Increased amount of weapon spawners
- Nerfed Chips from 10 hits to kill to 12
- Nerfed Pizza slightly
- Buffed Satellite Dish slightly for the first two shots
- Increased spawn rate of weapons
- Increased player hitbox for passing the Bomb

[h2]Other improvements:[/h2]
- Fixed Hair Fryer fire not being shown for other players
- Other player's hands while holding Satellite dish are now hidden
- Bomb siren now plays correctly
- Weapons no longer spawn on top of each other
- Fixed a glitch which would cause a player to get stuck in the Loading... animation
- Added credits to the menu song used.
- Optimized game in cases where you've been connected to a server for a long time
- Version check for future versions so people can't connect to a newer version server while on an outdated version
- A new achievement (secret, I won't tell you what it is lol)

[i]Oh and by the way, I'd really appreciate if you could drop a positive review on Steam. The game is free, and would mean a lot :)[/i]
